title: Close Luobi
description: Minimize Luobi to the system tray, or quit completely?
closeBehaviorDesc: What to do when the close button is clicked
option_askDesc: Show a dialog each time you close the window
option_minimizeDesc: Hide to the tray and keep running in the background
option_quitDesc: Close the window and exit the app
hint: Tip: with 'Minimize to tray', double-click the tray icon to quickly restore the window.
